ambiguities: First updates means four (zero-LR plus three nonzero), matching Screen S; no extended recovery.
SHA256 seed maps first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian to CPU torch.Generator; gate then up fp32 normal draws cast to stored dtype.

Utility uses causal response prediction positions and exact stage masks: D skips first three task tokens; replay CE includes all response tokens and EOS. Replay pools must be explicitly marked via --replay-pool or p3b_replay metadata.
Greedy comparison is bounded at 128 new tokens; token sequences including EOS compared exactly; truncation reported.
Logit comparison uses an fp32 head on the final hidden state at response prediction positions only (including EOS); fixed teacher-forced contexts; pooled entry quantiles use linear interpolation.
Timing uses median updates 2-4 to exclude first AdamW allocation; all individual times retained.
Mean response NLL is the EOS-inclusive sum of response-label NLL across the 32 prompts divided by their total response tokens; no task skip mask for damage measurement.
gradient_norm_gate: both directions within factor 2 at each of four updates, before clipping
greedy_reporting: changed output count and exact token sequences reported only; no gate
logits: fp32 head on final normalised hidden state; full vocabulary at response prediction positions only; p99/p99.9/max reported; only p99.9 gated
nll: mean teacher-forced EOS-inclusive response NLL across 32 prompts, weighted equally per token; rise <=0.1 nats/token
reason: m2_train/c_train require eight distinct GPUs; one H100 cannot hold fp32 masters, AdamW states, EMA, bf16 actor and rollout engine together
source: FinQA train only; first 256 rung-p-v1 hashes from the frozen D 1,441-row pool; no admitted replay available locally
targets: technical smoke uses FinQA executed gold answers, not verified 27B demonstrations
timing_gate: ratio of median wall step seconds for updates 2-4, including optimizer and EMA; exclude first state allocation equally
training: minimal response-only EOS-inclusive CE, mean per item then batch mean; full weights, bf16 forward/gradients, CPU fp32 AdamW master/state and EMA; fresh copies per arm
utility_eligibility: kit.c_d_prompt.d_prompt_eligible, shared with c_train; exclude over-cap prompts before hash ordering
utility_mask: D task loss mask, skip first three response tokens, causal prediction positions; no replay pool in this smoke
